D/ IMP CAESAR TRAIAN HADRIANVS AVG ; R/ P M TR P COS III VOT-PVB

A complete silver denarius of Hadrian dating to the period AD 119 to 122 (Reece period 6). P M TR P COS III VOT PVB reverse type depicting Pietas standing right raising both hands. Mint of Rome. RIC II, p. 357, no. 141. RSC 1477, BMC 324. Obverse description: Emperor, bust right, laureate. Obverse inscription: IMP CAESAR TRAIAN HADRIANVS AVG.
